title: When Voyage is briefly down or slow while a Developer builds the index, what should happen?
context: Chief architect gap: EX-integration-architect-2 (accepted, must) keeps today's retry ladder where only rate limits (429) are retried at 250/500/1000 ms, while EX-qa-engineer-2 (accepted) expects 5xx and network failures to be retried too. The voyageai SDK being removed retried short outages itself, so dropping it changes what a Developer sees during a Voyage blip. The plan reuses withRemoteRetry untouched (stop right away). Either way the new AbortSignal timeout surfaces as provider_error.
